sections.kicker: Prepared for Moracuyá by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Moracuyá has a name for its idea. The profile hides it.
sections.keep: The naming. Healthy Dealer is a line no other cafe in Monterrey can use.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet

pins.area: The bio lists five branch names and no line about what Moracuyá is
pins.what: The bio is a list of branch names.
pins.why: Five locations tell people where to go. They do not say why Moracuyá and not the other healthy menu in town.
pins.how: Open the bio with what Moracuyá is, then list the branches.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Visitors find an address book and no reason.

pins.area: The round profile photo carries the line where fresh meets tasty in tiny type
pins.what: The only tagline lives inside the profile photo.
pins.why: Where fresh meets tasty is small, round and unreadable at feed size.
pins.how: Move the line into the bio and the pinned posts.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The best summary is on a surface nobody reads.

pins.quote: Ya tienes a tu Healthy Dealer de confianza más cerca de ti.
pins.what: A caption gives the brand a person: your Healthy Dealer.
pins.why: It is playful, specific and ownable. It is the voice to build on.
pins.how: Use it as the recurring character across captions and highlights.
pins.label: Your voice
pins.cost: The idea appears once, so it never becomes the brand.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Moracuyá. I spent some time on your Instagram. Three things stood out, and all three point the same way.
